description: Hourly measurement of the NayaPOWER system, compiled by map_compiler.py. Judgments stay human; measurements are mechanical. A probe that cannot measure reports status 'unknown' loudly — never silent, never fake green.

measured_at.description: UTC timestamp of this compilation run.

evidence.description: Human-readable measurement detail: counts, ages, states, or the reason measurement was unavailable.

measured_at.description: UTC timestamp of this probe's measurement.

status.description: green: measured healthy. amber: measured, needs attention. red: measured, broken/missing. unknown: could not measure — loud, with reason in evidence.

probes.description: One entry per probe. Keys are probe names; new probes may be added over time.

summary.description: Count of probes per status. Must equal the number of entries in probes.

title: Living Map state file
